title: Admin - Comment Moderation - View List of Moderation Items - Functional Test Plan
overview: Functional testing of the Admin Comment Moderation - View List of Moderation Items feature on the Y4J platform. This feature displays all user queries, reviews, and vendor responses in a structured list with moderation cards showing author name, role tag, content type, date/time, product name, content text, report count badge, AI flags/Device Matcher Notes, and status badges. Covers card content, status display, conditional elements, and empty state.

testCases.title: Moderation card displays author name
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Comment Moderation page is loaded with at least one moderation item.
steps: Observe a moderation card in the list
expectedResults: Each moderation card displays the author's name
The name is clearly visible and readable
The name is not empty or placeholder text
testCases.postconditions: Author name is confirmed visible on moderation cards

testCases.title: Moderation card displays role tag (PwD / Caregiver / Vendor)
testCases.preconditions: User is logged in as Admin. Moderation items from different user roles exist.
expectedResults: Each card displays a role tag indicating the author's role
Role tags include: 'PwD', 'Caregiver', or 'Vendor'
The role tag is visually distinct (badge, colored label, or tag)
The role tag accurately reflects the author's actual role
testCases.postconditions: Role tags are confirmed visible and accurate

testCases.title: Moderation card displays content type (Query / Review / Vendor Response)

steps: Verify content type labels are displayed
expectedResults: Each card displays the content type

testCases.postconditions: Content types are confirmed visible and accurate

testCases.title: Report count badge is displayed when user reports exist
